definitionZh: ry CSS属性定义了一个SVG的Y轴或垂直半径和一个SVG矩形的角的垂直曲线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.
sourceDefinition: The ry CSS property defines the y-axis, or vertical, radius of an SVG and the vertical curve of the corners of an SVG rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
